notes: 0.3.30：插件配置真正跟得走，换机器不再丢。① 同步范围从 4 个设置文件扩到 13 项，把之前从没进过仓库的配置补上：桌宠记忆（dsh-pet\memory.json）、our-free-model 收藏（picks.json）、dsh-im 界面语言、QQ 集成配置与工作区（integrations\dsh-qq\config.json / workspaces.json）、红队预设声明（redteam\preset-declare.json）、任务板台账与调度（task-board\ledger-v2.json / scheduler-v2.json），以及最关键的 DSH 工作区登记（storages\workspace.json）——新机器「配置没了」多半就是它没同步，工作区列表根本没被带过去。凭据与运行时状态仍然排除（channel-pack 的 token-ledger、workbuddy-vault、QQ bot state、stats/feed/catalog/会话缓存）。② 带本机绝对路径的配置不再把老机器的盘符写死到新机器：capture 写进仓库前把安装目录 / .dsh / 工作区根换成 {{APP_ROOT}}、{{DSH_HOME}}、{{WORKSPACE_HOME}}，用户自选目录换成 {{ROOT:<key>}}；仓库里一律正斜杠，JSON 不会有反斜杠转义问题。apply 落地前展开成本机路径。③ 路径确认：展开不掉的占位符（这台机器还没确认过的根）就跳过不写、记进 config-sync-pending-paths.json，面板「本机路径」卡把这些项列出来（哪个 token、哪个文件、要选什么目录），填好保存后重新拉取即可。确认值存在 <dshHome>\config-sync-roots.json（本机私有、不进仓库），确认过的下次不再问。不写比乱写好：把 {{ROOT:xxx}} 字面量写进配置，插件读到会当真实路径，报错更难查。④ 面板新增「问题反馈」卡：标题 + 详情提交后落成仓库 feedback\<时间戳>-<id>.json（带版本、机器名、状态），随后 git commit + push 到 GitHub；另一台机器拉取后同样在面板里看到。推送失败不算失败——文件已留在本机仓库，下次推送会一起上去。
notesEn: 0.3.30: plugin configs now actually travel with the sync, so a new machine no longer starts empty. (1) The settings group grows from 4 files to 13, adding what never made it into the repo: pet memory (dsh-pet\memory.json), our-free-model picks (picks.json), dsh-im interface language, QQ integration config and workspaces (integrations\dsh-qq\config.json / workspaces.json), redteam preset declarations (redteam\preset-declare.json), task-board ledger and scheduler (task-board\ledger-v2.json / scheduler-v2.json), and most importantly the DSH workspace registry (storages\workspace.json) - the usual reason a new machine "lost its config" is that the workspace list never came over. Credentials and runtime state stay excluded (channel-pack token-ledger, workbuddy-vault, QQ bot state, stats/feed/catalog/session caches). (2) Configs with absolute paths no longer carry the old machine's drive letters into the new one: before writing to the repo, capture replaces the install root, .dsh folder and workspace root with {{APP_ROOT}}, {{DSH_HOME}} and {{WORKSPACE_HOME}}, and user-chosen folders with {{ROOT:<key>}}; the repo always stores forward slashes, so JSON never needs backslash escaping. apply expands them back on landing. (3) Path confirmation: a placeholder that cannot be expanded (a root this machine has not confirmed yet) makes that file be skipped instead of written, and it is recorded into config-sync-pending-paths.json. The panel's Local paths card lists those items (which token, which file, which folder to pick); fill them in, save, then pull again. Confirmed values live in <dshHome>\config-sync-roots.json (local only, never committed) and are not asked again. Not writing beats writing garbage: a literal {{ROOT:xxx}} in a config is read by plugins as a real path, and that error is much harder to trace. (4) New Feedback card in the panel: a title and details are stored as feedback\<timestamp>-<id>.json (with version, machine name and status), then committed and pushed to GitHub; the other machine sees the same list after pulling. A failed push is not a failed report - the file stays in the local repo and goes up with the next push.
